intent: Reject typed TLS and cancellation failures before either retry callback can change dispatch uncertainty.
finding: The prior isRetryable correction prevented a second attempt, but executeWithRetry still invoked shouldRetryFailure and shouldRetry first. The actual OpenAI chat and responses callbacks can interpret recovery wording as a pre-execution failure and clear the actual ProviderDispatchRetryGuard's unknown remote outcome before the typed terminal refusal. The reproduced defect is lost uncertainty, not a second dispatch.

correction.source: Classify the caught failure with the existing cycle-safe 16-cause networkFailureKind before both callbacks, and immediately propagate TLS or CANCELLED failures unchanged.
preserved: The existing isRetryable TLS/cancellation correction and every prior test method and assertion
Durable rate-limit ownership, worker-budget ownership, maximum attempts, backoff and timeouts
Failure-specific callback before the general dispatch gate for ordinary transient failures
The actual ProviderDispatchRetryGuard implementation, provider request configuration and both OpenAI callback implementations

focusedValidation.baseline: Actual c2d retry source with current project tests ran 24 methods with exactly two expected failures: retry callbacks were invoked for a typed terminal error, and the actual Gateway guard lost its unknown remote outcome. Zero ignored methods.
focusedValidation.corrected: All 19 ResilientStreamingClientTest methods and five NetworkFailureKindTest methods passed, zero failures or ignored methods. All 16 previously present retry methods and assertions are byte-preserved.
focusedValidation.causeControls: Direct and 16-deep SSLProtocolException, CertPathValidatorException and CancellationException with misleading recovery wording; both callback counters; actual guard uncertainty; genuine UnknownHostException recovery and exact failure-specific/general/retry callback order.
focusedValidation.executionBoundary: Whole verbatim project retry client, classifier, ProviderDispatchRetryGuard and tests. The previously approved ProviderHttpFailure/ProviderConnectivityPendingException class extractions and uncalled WorkerRequestBudget-method omissions are unchanged. The explicitly approved ProviderRequestConfig declaration-only seam retains its exact package and constructor prefix through extraHeaders, including original defaults; unused remaining fields, imports, buildEndpoint and top-level helpers are omitted. No initializer or property transformation is removed, and the executed guard reads only the exact extraHeaders field. Exact complete-source, extraction, dependency and method hashes are retained in the review evidence.
focusedValidation.limitations: Synthetic throwables and virtual coroutine time only. This proof does not qualify full ProviderRequestConfig, provider HTTP transport, Android, worker-budget methods, UI, devices, composed private streams or the complete project suite. Current-source canonical and hosted qualification remain required.

integration: Preparation used an isolated worktree without a commit, remote write or CI action. The parent coordinator owns current-head reconciliation, generated references and release scope, canonical validation, guarded append and final-source hosted qualification. Other implementation and publication holds remain independent.
